description: Confirm a held slot with the customer's name and phone number; this is the booking. Idempotent: confirming the same hold twice books it once and tells the business once. A business that confirms every visit itself answers `hold.awaiting: true` with the hold still `held`: the slot is kept, the business decides, and the person gets an SMS either way; tell them that and promise no time. With a linked number (link_phone) you may send `contact` with the name alone and the linked number is used; a different number in `contact.phone` is refused as `phone-mismatch`.

contact.description: The customer's own name and phone number (9 digits, or +country code and the number). Ask them; never invent one. With a linked number the phone may be left out.

hold.description: The `id` of the hold to confirm.

session.description: The session id the hold was made in.

name: confirm_booking
